seo.title: Partners – Luis Schulz
seo.description: I'm looking for partners to support me on my way into professional triathlon.

title: Partners
lead: Turning pro is also a financial step. I'm looking for partners who support me along the way and with whom I can work long-term.

benefits.title: A look into my training
benefits.text: I show on my channels what my everyday life as a triathlete really looks like. I only feature products I actually use.

benefits.title: Race-day presence
benefits.text: Your logo on my race kit and equipment. I mention you in my race reports.

benefits.title: Honest feedback
benefits.text: I test equipment in training and racing and tell you openly what works and what doesn't.

benefits.title: Joint activities
benefits.text: Workshops, group runs or content for your customers. We'll work out together what suits you.

ctaText: I'm happy to send you my documents and tell you more about my plans.
